title: Extra Weapons
body:
## ExtraWeapons ExtraWeapons adds **30+** unique weapons, armor, and items. Perfect for SMP servers and RPG servers. ![Player using the AntiFlight Stick on a flying bee](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e0aa621e95d6a2b9732c87f92183a27e8485e46e.gif) ### Features - Custom weapons - Custom armor - Custom items - Configurable stats
Current Items ## Thunder Set ### Stats - Helmet Defense: +3 - Chestplate Defense: +8 - Leggings Defense: +6 - Boots Defense: +3 ### Full Set Bonus - Landing hits build Voltage. (1/s) - Sneak at max Voltage to become Overcharged for 5s. --- ## Earthquake Boots ### Stats - Defense: +3 ### Passive - Fall damage releases a shockwave that damages and slows enemies inside. - Cooldown: 7s --- ## Blink Dagger ### Stats - Damage: +7 ### [Right-Click] - Teleports you behind the targeted enemy. - Cooldown: 10s --- ## Jetpack ### Stats - Defense: +3 ### [Shift-Hold] - Consumes fuel to enable flight. - Fuel: 100 ### Passive - When fuel runs out, it fully recharges after a short period. - Grant immunity to fall damage. --- ## Tracker Bow ### Passive - Arrows auto lock on enemies. - Shots travel 25% slower. --- ## Titan Chestplate ### Stats - Health: +10 hearts - Speed: -20% ### Passive - Reduces incoming damage by 20% - Reduces damage dealt by 20% --- ## Frost Orb ### [Right-Click] - Launch the frozen orb. - Landing 4 consecutive hits freezes the enemy for 1.5s. --- ## Molten Edge ### Stats - Damage: +6 ### Passive - Take 25% less damage from fire ticks. - Deal 50% more base damage while on fire. - Fire ticks last 50% longer. --- ## Shockwave Chestplate ### Stats - Defense: +8 ### [Shift-Click] - Releases a shockwave that pushes nearby enemies away. - Cooldown: 7s --- ## Magnet ### [Right-Click] - Pulls nearby dropped items to you. - Cooldown: 5s --- ## Molten Leggings ### Stats - Defense: +6 ### Passive - Hits burn enemies while on fire. - Fire ticks last 50% longer. --- ## Anti-Flight Stick ### [Right-Click] - Fires a beam that forces flyers to land. - Cooldown: 7s --- ## Longsword ### Stats - Damage: +8 - Range: +3 ### Passive - Deals less damage up close. --- ## Vampire Blade ### Stats - Damage: +7 ### Passive - Restores 25% of damage dealt as health. - Cooldown: 1s --- ## Last Strike ### Stats - Damage: +7 ### Passive - Deals more damage the lower your health is - +100% (25% HP), +50% (50% HP) --- ## Speedster Boots ### Stats - Defense: +2 ### Passive - Adds 50% speed, consume more hunger during movement. --- ## Gravity Chestplate ### Stats - Defense: +8 ### [Shift-Click] - Pulls nearby enemies toward you. - Cooldown: 7s --- ## Gravity Leggings ### Stats - Defense: +6 ### Passive - Take 50% less knockback. - Fall 25% faster. --- ## Dual Blade ### Stats - Damage: +5 ### Passive - Deals double base damage while holding another Dual Blade in your offhand. --- ## Short Dagger ### Stats - Damage: +6 ### Passive - Deals 2x damage when striking an enemy from behind. --- ## Shock Blade ### Stats - Damage: +5 ### [Right-Click] - Releases a small explosion dealing 7 damage to nearby enemies. - Cost: 250 XP - Cooldown: 0.25s --- ## Shuriken ### [Right-Click] - Shoots the shuriken dealing 4 damage. - Cooldown: 0.5s --- ## First Strike ### Stats - Damage: +7 ### Passive - Deals more damage the higher your health is - +100% (100% HP), +50% (75% HP) --- ## Gravity Blade ### Stats - Damage: +6 ### Passive - Pulls enemies toward you. --- ## Ink Bomb ### [Right-Click] - Launches an ink bomb, blinding all enemies caught in the blast. - Cooldown: 10s --- ## Launch Bow ### Passive - Launches the shooter forward instead of firing. - Cooldown: 3s --- ## Shortbow ### [Right-Click] - Shoots arrows instantly. - Cooldown: 0.25s --- ## Healing Wand ### [Right-Click] - Restores 5 hearts on use. - Cooldown: 7s --- ## Infinite Beef ### [Right-Click] - Restores hunger. - Cooldown: 20s --- ## Infinite Firework ### [Right-Click] - Boosts elytra flight. --- ## Thunder Rod ### [Right-Click] - Strikes lightning at the target location, dealing 5 damage to nearby enemies. - Cooldown: 7s ---
## Commands | Command |Permission| Description | |-|-|-| |`/extraweapons get `|extraweapons.admin|Get custom item| |`/extraweapons reload`|extraweapons.admin|Reload configs (right/left click held item to update lore)| |`/extraweapons menu`|extraweapons.admin|Opens a menu containing all custom items| ### Supported Version 1.21.x - 26.1.2
